1: /**
2:  * dsh-native-pp-projection — the ProgressContract as a pure fold over DSH
3:  * session events (docs/16-native-pp-experiment.md).
4:  *
5:  * The whole capability is:
6:  *   - createFolder(): an incremental pure fold consuming session records;
7:  *   - foldProjection(events): the one-shot form over an event list;
8:  *   - a host plugin that subscribes to `session/event` only, times its own
9:  *     per-event handling (blocking_host_cost), and writes one projection JSON
10:  *     per run at disposal.
11:  *
12:  * Hard-constraint audit (constraints #4-#8): this module imports only
13:  * node:fs / node:perf_hooks, registers ZERO tools, never reads the agent,
14:  * tools, llm, or prompt services, and never writes to the session log. The
15:  * surface report in projection.json makes that auditable per run.
16:  */
17: import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
18: import { join } from "node:path";
19: import { performance } from "node:perf_hooks";
20: 
21: export const name = "native-pp-projection";
22: 
23: /**
24:  * Capability effect model: for each capability, the session event types whose
25:  * records embody the capability's world effect. An empty list means the effect
26:  * produces no observable event → the effect verdict must be `unknown` whenever
27:  * the capability was called (constraint #2: unobservable effects are unknown,
28:  * never fabricated).
29:  */
30: export const EFFECT_EVENT_TYPES = {
31:   exp_report: ["tool/result"],
32:   exp_flaky: ["tool/result"],
33:   exp_unobservable: [], // file write emits no session event
34: };
35: 
36: const USAGE_FIELDS = ["inputTokens", "outputTokens", "cacheReadTokens", "cacheWriteTokens", "reasoningTokens"];
37: 
38: /** Incremental pure fold over session records. */
39: export function createFolder() {
40:   const state = {
41:     events: 0,
42:     turns: [],
43:     openTurn: null,
44:     steps: 0,
45:     toolCalls: [], // {seq, name, id}
46:     callIdToName: new Map(),
47:     goal: null,
48:     effects: {}, // tool -> {called, calls, callResult, worldEffect, support}
49:     usage: Object.fromEntries(USAGE_FIELDS.map((f) => [f, 0])),
50:     turnOutcome: null,
51:     unknownFields: [],
52:   };
53: 
54:   function closeTurn() {
55:     if (state.openTurn) state.turns.push(state.openTurn);
56:     state.openTurn = null;
57:   }
58: 
59:   function onEvent(event) {
60:     // session/end-seed is a log-only seed-boundary marker appended by the
61:     // Session constructor on official restore (E3 table). It carries no
62:     // execution/effect semantics; the live stream never contains it.
63:     if (event?.type === "session/end-seed") return;
64:     state.events += 1;
65:     const data = event?.data ?? {};
66:     switch (event?.type) {
67:       case "turn/start": {
68:         closeTurn();
69:         state.openTurn = {
70:           turn: data.turn ?? null,
71:           steps: 0,
72:           toolCalls: 0,
73:           toolErrors: 0,
74:           reason: null,
75:         };
76:         break;
77:       }
78:       case "step/start": {
79:         state.steps += 1;
80:         if (state.openTurn) state.openTurn.steps += 1;
81:         break;
82:       }
83:       case "tool/call": {
84:         const id = data.callId ?? data.id ?? data.call_id ?? null;
85:         const tname = String(data.name ?? data.toolName ?? "unknown");
86:         state.toolCalls.push({ seq: event.seq, name: tname, id });
87:         if (id !== null) state.callIdToName.set(String(id), tname);
88:         break;
89:       }
90:       case "tool/result": {
91:         // E3 semantics table: tool/result carries callId at
92:         // data.message.source.callId; the error signal is EMPIRICALLY the
93:         // ToolResultBlock-level isError flag inside data.message.content[]
94:         // (data.error stays absent for thrown tools on this DSH version).
95:         const id = data.callId ?? data.id ?? data.call_id ?? data.message?.source?.callId ?? null;
96:         const resolved = String(data.name ?? data.toolName ?? (id !== null ? state.callIdToName.get(String(id)) : null) ?? "unknown");
97:         const blocks = Array.isArray(data.message?.content) ? data.message.content : [];
98:         const isError = Boolean(
99:           data.isError === true ||
100:           data.error !== undefined ||
101:           blocks.some((block) => block?.isError === true),
102:         );
103:         if (state.openTurn) {
104:           state.openTurn.toolCalls += 1;
105:           if (isError) state.openTurn.toolErrors += 1;
106:         }
107:         const effect = state.effects[resolved] ?? (state.effects[resolved] = {
108:           called: false,
109:           calls: [],
110:           callResult: null,
111:           worldEffect: "unknown",
112:           support: [],
113:         });
114:         effect.called = true;
115:         effect.calls.push({ seq: event.seq, isError });
116:         effect.callResult = isError ? "failed" : "success";
117:         break;
118:       }
119:       case "turn/end": {
120:         if (state.openTurn) state.openTurn.reason = data.reason ?? null;
121:         closeTurn();
122:         state.turnOutcome = data.reason?.kind ?? null;
123:         break;
124:       }
125:       case "goal/change": {
126:         const change = data.change ?? data;
127:         state.goal = {
128:           operation: change.operation ?? null,
129:           phase: change.goal?.phase ?? null,
130:           revision: change.goal?.revision ?? null,
131:           roundsStarted: change.roundsStarted ?? null,
132:           support: [event.seq],
133:         };
134:         break;
135:       }
136:       case "assistant/message": {
137:         const usage = data.usage ?? {};
138:         for (const field of USAGE_FIELDS) {
139:           if (typeof usage[field] === "number") state.usage[field] += usage[field];
140:         }
141:         break;
142:       }
143:       default:
144:         break;
145:     }
146:   }
147: 
148:   function result() {
149:     if (state.openTurn) closeTurn();
150:     // World-effect verdicts: event-support rule (constraints #1-#3).
151:     // Each verdict cites the supporting record seqs; a called capability whose
152:     // effect has no supporting record (or whose effect model declares it
153:     // unobservable) is reported unknown — never fabricated.
154:     for (const [toolName, effect] of Object.entries(state.effects)) {
155:       const types = EFFECT_EVENT_TYPES[toolName] ?? ["tool/result"];
156:       if (types.length > 0 && types.includes("tool/result")) {
157:         // The recorded tool result embodies this capability's effect.
158:         effect.support = effect.calls.map((call) => call.seq);
159:         effect.worldEffect = effect.callResult ?? "unknown";
160:         if (effect.callResult === null) state.unknownFields.push(`effects.${toolName}.worldEffect`);
161:       } else {
162:         // Declared unobservable effect: no event type embodies it.
163:         effect.support = [];
164:         effect.worldEffect = "unknown";
165:         if (effect.called) state.unknownFields.push(`effects.${toolName}.worldEffect`);
166:       }
167:     }
168:     const toolErrors = state.turns.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.toolErrors, 0);
169:     const verdict = {
170:       turn: state.turnOutcome,
171:       execution: state.toolCalls.length === 0 ? "none" : toolErrors > 0 ? "failed" : "success",
172:       effect: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(state.effects).map(([k, e]) => [k, e.worldEffect])),
173:     };
174:     return {
175:       axes: {
176:         execution: {
177:           turns: state.turns.length,
178:           steps: state.steps,
179:           toolCalls: state.toolCalls.length,
180:           toolErrors,
181:           turnHistory: state.turns,
182:           turnOutcome: state.turnOutcome,
183:         },
184:         goal: state.goal,
185:         effect: state.effects,
186:       },
187:       verdict,
188:       unknownFields: [...state.unknownFields],
189:       usage: { ...state.usage },
190:       foldStats: { events: state.events, foldMs: null },
191:     };
192:   }
193: 
194:   return { onEvent, result };
195: }
196: 
197: /** One-shot fold over an event list (replay / offline verification). */
198: export function foldProjection(events) {
199:   const t0 = performance.now();
200:   const folder = createFolder();
201:   for (const event of events) folder.onEvent(event);
202:   const projection = folder.result();
203:   projection.foldStats.foldMs = Math.round((performance.now() - t0) * 1000) / 1000;
204:   return projection;
205: }
206: 
207: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
208: // Host plugin: live subscription to session/event only.
209: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
210: 
211: export function apply(ctx) {
212:   // Replay cells (pp-r) mount this plugin too; the fold there is driven by the
213:   // fixture's replay runner over the RESTORED log, so the live subscription
214:   // (and its exit-time write) must stay silent in replay mode — otherwise the
215:   // empty live fold would overwrite the live projection file.
216:   if (String(process.env.EXP_MODE ?? "live").trim().toLowerCase() === "replay") return;
217:   const resultsDir = String(process.env.EXP_RESULTS_DIR ?? "").trim();
218:   if (!resultsDir) return;
219: 
220:   const scenario = String(process.env.EXP_SCENARIO ?? "ok").toLowerCase();
221:   const run = String(process.env.EXP_RUN ?? "r1").replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "");
222:   const runId = `${scenario}-${run}`;
223: 
224:   let sessionId = null;
225:   let finalized = false;
226:   const folder = createFolder();
227:   const hostTiming = { totalUs: 0, events: 0, avgUsPerEvent: 0 };
228:   let lastEventTime = 0;
229: 
230:   const surface = {
231:     toolsRegistered: 0,
232:     agentApisCalled: 0,
233:     llmApisCalled: 0,
234:     promptEdits: 0,
235:   };
236: 
237:   ctx.on("session/event", (session, event) => {
238:     try {
239:       if (sessionId !== null && session?.id !== sessionId) return;
240:       if (sessionId === null) sessionId = session?.id ?? null;
241:       const t0 = performance.now();
242:       folder.onEvent(event);
243:       const dt = performance.now() - t0;
244:       hostTiming.totalUs += dt * 1000;
245:       hostTiming.events += 1;
246:       lastEventTime = event.time ?? lastEventTime;
247:     } catch {
248:       /* the fold must never break the session */
249:     }
250:   });
251: 
252:   function finalize() {
253:     if (finalized) return;
254:     finalized = true;
255:     try {
256:       hostTiming.avgUsPerEvent = hostTiming.events > 0 ? Math.round((hostTiming.totalUs / hostTiming.events) * 100) / 100 : 0;
257:       const projection = folder.result();
258:       projection.foldStats.foldMs = Math.round(hostTiming.totalUs) / 1000;
259:       const payload = {
260:         run: runId,
261:         sessionId,
262:         writtenAt: Date.now(),
263:         lastEventTime,
264:         projection,
265:         hostTiming,

24:  * Chain (rchain only, bounded): after a dispatched hop the pre-step handler

43: /**

51:     id: "plugin-revision-mismatch",
52:     kind: "revision",
53:     required: (proj) => proj.artifact !== null && proj.runtime !== null && proj.artifact.rev !== proj.runtime.rev,
54:     action: { name: "pwsh", arguments: { command: "& .\\reload.ps1", description: "Reload runtime to match artifact revision" } },

77:   rcguard: ["plugin-revision-mismatch"],
78:   rcmulti: ["plugin-revision-mismatch", "plugin-revision-rollback"],

94: function env() {

105: function textOf(content) {
106:   return (content ?? [])
107:     .map((block) => (block?.type === "text" ? String(block.text ?? "") : ""))
108:     .join("");

111: /** Unwrap a tool-result MESSAGE into its flat text (the wrapper's inner content). */
112: function toolResultText(message) {
113:   const content = message?.content ?? [];
114:   let text = "";
115:   for (const block of content) {
116:     if (block?.type === "text") text += String(block.text ?? "");
117:     else if (block?.type === "tool-result" && Array.isArray(block.content)) text += textOf(block.content);
118:   }

122: export function apply(ctx) {

132:   const state = {
133:     sessionId: null,
134:     finalized: false,
135:     lastDecisionKey: null,
136:     metrics: {
137:       run: runId,
138:       scenario: cfg.scenario,
139:       arm: cfg.arm,

143:       blocked: 0,

157:   function logIntervention(kind, data) {

161:   function recordDecision(kind, data) {

170:   /** Narrow fact-source gate: per command SEGMENT (split on ; | & newlines). */
171:   function pwshSegments(callArguments) {
172:     try {
173:       const parsed = JSON.parse(callArguments);
174:       return String(parsed?.command ?? "").split(/[;&|\r\n]+/);
175:     } catch {
176:       return [];
177:     }
178:   }

180:   function segmentExecutesScript(segment, script) {
181:     const seg = String(segment ?? "").trim();
182:     if (/^(get-content|type|cat|select-string)\b/i.test(seg)) return false;
183:     // The world is the run cwd: script references must be relative. Absolute
184:     // paths or .. escapes would execute a TEMPLATE copy (smoke-observed leak:
185:     // the model read/ran files under the world templates directory).
186:     if (/^[A-Za-z]:/.test(seg) || /(^|[\s;&|])\.\./.test(seg)) return false;
187:     const escaped = script.replace(/\./g, "\\.");
188:     return new RegExp(`(^|\\s)(&\\s*)?[.\\\\/]*${escaped}\\b`, "i").test(seg);
189:   }

191:   function pwshRunsScript(callArguments, script) {
192:     return pwshSegments(callArguments).some((segment) => segmentExecutesScript(segment, script));
193:   }

195:   /**
196:    * Read-channel path scoping: a file observation counts as a world fact only
197:    * when the path belongs to the RUN world (relative to the session cwd, or
198:    * absolute inside the results dir). Reading a same-named file anywhere else
199:    * (e.g. the experiment's world templates) must not produce facts
200:    * (smoke-observed false REQUIRED).
201:    */
202:   function readFilePath(callArguments) {
203:     try {
204:       const parsed = JSON.parse(callArguments);
205:       return String(parsed?.file_path ?? "");
206:     } catch {
207:       return "";
208:     }
209:   }

211:   function isWorldFilePath(filePath) {
212:     const normalized = String(filePath ?? "").replace(/\\/g, "/");
213:     if (!/^[A-Za-z]:\//.test(normalized) && !normalized.startsWith("/")) return true; // relative to the run cwd
214:     const resultsPrefix = String(resultsDir ?? "").replace(/\\/g, "/").toLowerCase();
215:     if (resultsPrefix && normalized.toLowerCase().startsWith(`${resultsPrefix}/`)) return true;
216:     return false;
217:   }

219:   /** Contract's action with scenario overrides applied. */
220:   function actionOf(contractId) {
221:     const contract = CONTRACTS[contractId];
222:     const override = SCENARIO_ACTION_OVERRIDE[cfg.scenario];
223:     if (!override || contractId !== "plugin-revision-mismatch") return contract.action;
224:     return { name: contract.action.name, arguments: { ...contract.action.arguments, ...override } };
225:   }

227:   /**
228:    * Pure projection over the session event log (the ONLY fact source).
229:    * - artifact: latest "artifact=N" from a pwsh result that EXECUTES a
230:    *   fact-declared script (build.ps1 / stale-bump-artifact.ps1) in some
231:    *   segment, or latest "revision" from a read of artifact.json;
232:    * - runtime: latest "runtime_revision=N" from a pwsh result that EXECUTES
233:    *   verify/reload/stale-bump scripts, or from a read of runtime-state.txt;
234:    * - executions: scripts executed via pwsh (per-segment gate) — the durable
235:    *   "what ran" facts for post-conditions;
236:    * - continuationSeq: latest runtime/continuation seq per contract id.
237:    */
238:   function project(session) {
239:     const events = session.events;
240:     const callArgs = new Map();
241:     for (const event of events) {
242:       if (event.type === "tool/call" && event.data?.callId !== undefined) {
243:         callArgs.set(String(event.data.callId), {
244:           name: String(event.data.name ?? ""),
245:           arguments: String(event.data.arguments ?? ""),
246:         });
247:       }
248:     }
249:     let artifact = null;
250:     let runtime = null;
251:     const executions = new Set();
252:     const continuationSeq = new Map();
253:     for (const event of events) {
254:       if (event.type === "runtime/continuation" && event.data?.contract !== undefined) {
255:         continuationSeq.set(String(event.data.contract), event.seq);
256:       }
257:       if (event.type === "tool/call" && event.data?.name === "pwsh") {
258:         for (const script of ["build.ps1", "verify.ps1", "reload.ps1", "reload-slow.ps1", "stale-bump.ps1", "stale-bump-artifact.ps1", "rollback.ps1", "healthcheck.ps1"]) {
259:           if (pwshRunsScript(event.data.arguments, script)) executions.add(script);
260:         }
261:       }
262:       if (event.type !== "tool/result") continue;
263:       const callId = event.data?.callId ?? event.data?.message?.source?.callId;
264:       const call = callId !== undefined ? callArgs.get(String(callId)) : null;
265:       if (!call) continue;
266:       const text = toolResultText(event.data?.message);
267:       if (call.name === "pwsh") {
268:         if (pwshRunsScript(call.arguments, "build.ps1") || pwshRunsScript(call.arguments, "stale-bump-artifact.ps1")) {
269:           const match = ARTIFACT_PATTERN.exec(text);
270:           if (match) artifact = { rev: Number(match[1]), seq: event.seq };
271:         }
272:         if (
273:           pwshRunsScript(call.arguments, "verify.ps1") ||
274:           pwshRunsScript(call.arguments, "reload.ps1") ||
275:           pwshRunsScript(call.arguments, "reload-slow.ps1") ||
276:           pwshRunsScript(call.arguments, "stale-bump.ps1")
277:         ) {
278:           const match = RUNTIME_PATTERN.exec(text);
279:           if (match) runtime = { rev: Number(match[1]), seq: event.seq };
280:         }
281:       } else if (call.name === "read") {
282:         const filePath = readFilePath(call.arguments);
283:         if (!isWorldFilePath(filePath)) continue;
284:         if (/artifact\.json$/i.test(filePath)) {
285:           const match = /"revision"\s*:\s*(\d+)/.exec(text);
286:           if (match) artifact = { rev: Number(match[1]), seq: event.seq };
287:         }
288:         if (/runtime-state\.txt$/i.test(filePath)) {
289:           const match = RUNTIME_PATTERN.exec(text);
290:           if (match) runtime = { rev: Number(match[1]), seq: event.seq };
291:         }
292:       }
293:     }
294:     return { artifact, runtime, executions, continuationSeq };
295:   }

297:   /** Bounded wait on the staleness/cancel injection handshake (always settles). */
298:   function waitFor(promise, ms) {
299:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
300:       const timer = setTimeout(() => resolve(), ms);
301:       promise.then(() => {
302:         clearTimeout(timer);
303:         resolve();
304:       });
305:     });
306:   }

308:   /** Classify the next legal action set: unique REQUIRED / ambiguous / none. */
309:   function classify(proj) {
310:     const candidates = activeContracts.filter((contract) => contract.required(proj));
311:     if (candidates.length === 0) return { kind: "none", candidates: [] };
312:     if (candidates.length > 1) return { kind: "ambiguous", candidates };
313:     return { kind: "required", contract: candidates[0] };
314:   }

316:   /** True when the canonical result shape indicates a guard/approval denial. */
317:   function isGuardDenial(result) {
318:     const text = textOf(result?.content ?? []);
319:     return result?.isError === true && text.startsWith("Error: ");
320:   }

322:   /** One continuation hop: CAS + dispatch + loop-contract records + provenance. */
323:   async function dispatchHop(session, payload, contract, proj) {
324:     const basedOn = {
325:       artifactRev: proj.artifact?.rev ?? null,
326:       artifactSeq: proj.artifact?.seq ?? null,
327:       runtimeRev: proj.runtime?.rev ?? null,
328:       runtimeSeq: proj.runtime?.seq ?? null,
329:     };
330:     const exec = {
331:       name: contract.action.name,
332:       arguments: { ...actionOf(contract.id).arguments },
333:       callId: `cont_${Date.now()}_${state.metrics.dispatches + state.metrics.blocked + state.metrics.aborted + 1}`,
334:       agent: payload.agent,
335:       signal: payload.signal,
336:     };
337: 
338:     let result;
339:     try {
340:       result = await ctx.tools.execute(exec);
341:     } catch (error) {
342:       state.metrics.blocked += 1;
343:       logIntervention("dispatch-error", { contract: contract.id, message: String(error?.message ?? error) });
344:       return { outcome: "blocked", exec, result: null };
345:     }
346: 
347:     const outcome = payload.signal.aborted ? "aborted" : isGuardDenial(result) ? "blocked" : "dispatched";
348: 
349:     let callSeq = null;
350:     let resultSeq = null;
351:     try {
352:       session.append(
353:         "assistant/message",
354:         {
355:           turn: payload.turn,
356:           step: payload.step,
357:           message: {
358:             role: "assistant",
359:             id: randomUUID(),
360:             source: { kind: "runtime-continuation", contract: contract.kind, callId: exec.callId },
361:             content: [{ type: "tool-call", id: exec.callId, name: exec.name, arguments: JSON.stringify(exec.arguments) }],
362:           },
363:         },
364:         { surfaceOp: "append" },
365:       );
366:       callSeq = session.append("tool/call", {
367:         turn: payload.turn,
368:         step: payload.step,
369:         callId: exec.callId,
370:         name: exec.name,
371:         arguments: JSON.stringify(exec.arguments),
372:       }).seq;
373:       const message = {
374:         role: "user",
375:         id: randomUUID(),
376:         source: { kind: "tool", callId: exec.callId },
377:         content: [
378:           { type: "tool-result", toolCallId: exec.callId, content: result.content ?? [], isError: result.isError === true },
379:         ],
380:       };
381:       const resultEvent = session.append(
382:         "tool/result",
383:         {
384:           turn: payload.turn,
385:           step: payload.step,
386:           message,
387:           ...(result.error?.info !== undefined ? { error: result.error.info } : {}),
388:           ...(result.meta !== undefined ? { meta: result.meta } : {}),
389:         },
390:         { surfaceOp: "append", sourceEventSeqs: [callSeq] },
391:       );
392:       resultSeq = resultEvent.seq;
393:       session.append("runtime/continuation", {
394:         kind: "runtime/continuation",
395:         version: 1,
396:         contract: contract.id,
397:         action: "reload",
398:         authority: "runtime-observation",
399:         outcome,
400:         basedOn,
401:         ...(outcome === "dispatched" ? { revision: { artifact: basedOn.artifactRev, runtime: basedOn.runtimeRev } } : {}),
402:         callSeq,
403:         resultSeq,
404:         resultIsError: result.isError === true,
405:       });
406:     } catch (error) {
407:       state.metrics.recordFailures += 1;
408:       logIntervention("record-failure", { stage: "dispatch-records", message: String(error?.message ?? error) });
409:     }
410: 
411:     if (outcome === "dispatched") state.metrics.dispatches += 1;
412:     else if (outcome === "blocked") state.metrics.blocked += 1;
413:     else if (outcome === "aborted") state.metrics.aborted += 1;
414:     logIntervention(outcome, { contract: contract.id, callId: exec.callId, callSeq, resultSeq, resultIsError: result?.isError === true });
415: 
416:     return {
417:       outcome,
418:       exec,
419:       result,
420:       basedOn,
421:       text: result === null ? "" : toolResultText({ content: result.content ?? [] }),
422:     };
423:   }

425:   ctx.on("agent/pre-step", async (payload, next) => {
426:     const decision = await next();
427:     try {
428:       if (state.sessionId !== null && payload?.agent?.id !== state.sessionId) return decision;
429:       if (state.sessionId === null && payload?.agent?.id) state.sessionId = payload.agent.id;
430:       const session = payload?.agent?.session;
431:       if (!session || typeof session.append !== "function") return decision;
432: 
433:       // ---- classify once per pre-step ----
434:       let proj = project(session);
435:       const { artifact, runtime, continuationSeq } = proj;
436:       const classification = classify(proj);
437:       if (classification.kind === "ambiguous") {
438:         state.metrics.ambiguous += 1;
439:         recordDecision("ambiguous", {
440:           artifact: artifact?.rev ?? null,
441:           runtime: runtime?.rev ?? null,
442:           candidates: classification.candidates.map((c) => c.id),
443:         });
444:         return decision;
445:       }
446:       if (classification.kind === "none") {
447:         if (artifact === null || runtime === null) {
448:           recordDecision("needs-decision", { artifact: artifact?.rev ?? null, runtime: runtime?.rev ?? null });
449:         } else if (artifact.rev === runtime.rev) {
450:           recordDecision("complete", { artifact: artifact.rev, runtime: runtime.rev });
451:         } else {
452:           recordDecision("contracts-satisfied-none", { artifact: artifact.rev, runtime: runtime.rev });
453:         }
454:         return decision;
455:       }
456:       // REQUIRED (unique)
457:       const contract = classification.contract;
458:       if (continuationSeq.has(contract.id)) {
459:         recordDecision("already-continuated", { contract: contract.id, continuationSeq: continuationSeq.get(contract.id) });
460:         return decision;
461:       }
462: 
463:       // ---- handshake (staleness / cancellation injection window) ----
464:       state.metrics.intents += 1;
465:       const basedOnSnapshot = {
466:         artifactRev: artifact?.rev ?? null,
467:         artifactSeq: artifact?.seq ?? null,
468:         runtimeRev: runtime?.rev ?? null,
469:         runtimeSeq: runtime?.seq ?? null,
470:       };
471:       logIntervention("required", { contract: contract.id, basedOn: basedOnSnapshot });
472:       const deferred = { resolve: null, promise: null };
473:       deferred.promise = new Promise((resolve) => {
474:         deferred.resolve = resolve;
475:       });
476:       try {
477:         ctx.emit("exp/continuation-intent", {
478:           turn: payload.turn,
479:           step: payload.step,
480:           agent: payload.agent,
481:           session,
482:           signal: payload.signal,
483:           basedOn: basedOnSnapshot,
484:           deferred,
485:         });
486:       } catch {
487:         /* an emit failure must never break the loop */
488:       }
489:       await waitFor(deferred.promise, CAS_WAIT_MS);
490: 
491:       // ---- CAS: re-project; revisions moved? discard, never execute stale ----
492:       state.metrics.casChecks += 1;
493:       const now = project(session);
494:       const staleDetected =
495:         now.artifact?.rev !== basedOnSnapshot.artifactRev || now.runtime?.rev !== basedOnSnapshot.runtimeRev;
496:       if (staleDetected) {
497:         state.metrics.discards += 1;
498:         const observed = { artifactRev: now.artifact?.rev ?? null, runtimeRev: now.runtime?.rev ?? null };
499:         logIntervention("discarded-stale", { basedOn: basedOnSnapshot, observed });
500:         try {
501:           session.append("runtime/continuation", {
502:             kind: "runtime/continuation",
503:             version: 1,
504:             contract: contract.id,
505:             action: "reload",
506:             authority: "runtime-observation",
507:             outcome: "discarded",
508:             reason: "stale-cas",
509:             basedOn: basedOnSnapshot,
510:             observed,
511:           });
512:         } catch (error) {
513:           state.metrics.recordFailures += 1;
514:           logIntervention("record-failure", { stage: "discard-record", message: String(error?.message ?? error) });
515:         }
516:         if (cfg.inject && decision.kind === "enter" && !payload.signal.aborted) {
517:           const injected = {
518:             role: "user",
519:             id: randomUUID(),
520:             source: { kind: "plugin", plugin: "dsh-native-pp-continuation" },
521:             content: [
522:               {
523:                 type: "text",
524:                 text:
525:                   `[runtime-continuation] contract ${contract.id}: while the runtime was deciding, the world moved ` +
526:                   `(was artifact=${basedOnSnapshot.artifactRev} vs runtime=${basedOnSnapshot.runtimeRev}; the event stream now ` +
527:                   `observes artifact=${observed.artifactRev} runtime_revision=${observed.runtimeRev}), so the stale action was ` +
528:                   `discarded (CAS re-projection) and never executed. Digest the current facts and continue; do not replay the ` +
529:                   `stale decision.`,
530:               },
531:             ],
532:           };
533:           return { kind: "enter", messages: [...decision.messages, injected] };
534:         }
535:         return decision;
536:       }
537: 
538:       // ---- dispatch chain (bounded; Runtime A -> Runtime B -> Model) ----
539:       const hops = [];
540:       let chainResult = null;
541:       let nextContract = contract;
542:       for (let hop = 0; hop < MAX_CHAIN; hop += 1) {
543:         chainResult = await dispatchHop(session, payload, nextContract, proj);
544:         hops.push(chainResult);
545:         if (chainResult.outcome !== "dispatched" || payload.signal.aborted) break;
546:         state.metrics.chainHops += 1;
547:         if (hop + 1 >= MAX_CHAIN) break;
548:         proj = project(session);
549:         const nextClassification = classify(proj);
550:         if (nextClassification.kind !== "required") break;
551:         if (proj.continuationSeq.has(nextClassification.contract.id)) break;
552:         nextContract = nextClassification.contract;
553:       }
554:       if (hops.length > 1) state.metrics.chainRuns += 1;
555: 
556:       // ---- hand the already-happened facts to the model (one digest) ----
557:       if (cfg.inject && decision.kind === "enter" && !payload.signal.aborted) {
558:         const parts = hops.map((hop, index) => {
559:           const label =
560:             hop.outcome === "dispatched"
561:               ? `hop ${index + 1}: the runtime dispatched ${hop.exec.name} (${String(hop.exec.arguments?.command ?? "")}) via the normal tool pipeline; result: ${hop.text}`
